name: Camera Look-at Basis Construction
definition: Constructs an orthogonal camera coordinate system (basis) from a camera center and a look-at point (depth vector). It derives the up vector by projecting the world Z-axis onto the plane orthogonal to the camera direction, then computes the right vector via cross product.
summary: Camera Look-at Basis Construction builds an orthogonal camera coordinate system from a center and target, distinguishing itself by deriving an up vector orthogonal to the viewing direction via cross products.
